description: Advancing Knowledge on the Performance of Seismic Collectors in Steel Building Structures: Shake Table Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Robert Fleischman, University of Arizona (arizona.edu). NHERI @ UCSD large scale shake table tests on steel seismic collector project. Testing was conducted one story structural steel collector sensitive specimen representing an upper floor of a building structure. Special length steel column with pinned base were employed to provide appropriate inter story drift. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Collectors,  seismic collectors,  collector connections,  floor diaphragms,  composite slab,  steel buildings. Published 2026-01-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
